novel_features.name: Multi-instance registry
novel_features.description: Point the same commands at any ePropertyPlus land bank by slug; manage a list of known instances.
novel_features.rationale: The web UI serves one land bank at a time; a slug-parameterized client makes every ePropertyPlus land bank one uniform, queryable surface.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this to compare or batch across many land banks instead of one city's web portal.

novel_features.name: Structure vs lot classifier
novel_features.description: Filter an instance's inventory to structures (buildings) or vacant lots.
novel_features.rationale: Requires hydrating detail and applying the propertyClass/structureType rule the web UI never exposes as a filter.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use it to separate photographed buildings from vacant land for condition vs Land-Designer pipelines.

novel_features.name: Bulk hydrate-all
novel_features.description: Enumerate the index and hydrate every property's full detail into a local SQLite dataset.
novel_features.rationale: Index-to-detail fan-out across a whole instance into one queryable dataset; the UI paginates one property at a time.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this before any offline analysis, search, or export.

novel_features.name: GeoJSON land export
novel_features.description: Export inventory as GIS-ready GeoJSON features using lat/lng and parcel geometry.
novel_features.rationale: Joins coordinates and parcel dimensions into a GeoJSON shape no land-bank web UI exports.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use it to drop a land bank's parcels straight into GIS or the Land Designer.

novel_features.name: Land Designer feed
novel_features.description: Export vacant-land parcels with geometry, zoning, and potential use — the fields the Land Designer needs.
novel_features.rationale: Filters to land parcels and projects exactly the reuse-relevant fields; the UI has no such projection.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this to feed distressed-land parcels into adaptive-reuse visualization.

novel_features.name: Parcel/condition join hook
novel_features.description: Emit parcelNumber plus join instructions to county/Socrata condition and market-value data.
novel_features.rationale: parcelNumber is the external join key; only a local dataset can be joined against condition/assessment sources.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use it to attach city-graded condition and assessment to land-bank inventory.

novel_features.name: Cross-instance compare
novel_features.description: Compare synced inventories across two or more land-bank instances.
novel_features.rationale: Requires multiple synced local datasets side by side; impossible in any single-tenant web UI.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this to benchmark inventory size, structure ratio, or pricing across cities.

narrative.headline: Every land bank's public inventory, one command — enumerate, filter, export, and image any ePropertyPlus instance by slug.
narrative.value_prop: ePropertyPlus runs dozens of US land banks behind one-city-at-a-time web UIs. This CLI talks to their public JSON API parameterized by instance slug, hydrates the full inventory into a local SQLite dataset, splits structures from vacant lots, and exports CSV/GeoJSON for GIS, distressed-asset intelligence, and the Land Designer. No auth.

quickstart.comment: confirm the default instance (kclb) is reachable
enumerate + hydrate the whole inventory into the local store
list vacant lots as CSV for analysis
export land parcels as GeoJSON for GIS / Land Designer

troubleshoots.fix: Verify the slug: open https://public-<slug>.epropertyplus.com/landmgmtpub/ in a browser; set --instance <slug> or EPROPERTYPLUS_BASE_URL.

troubleshoots.symptom: custom-fields output looks like JS, not JSON
troubleshoots.fix: The upstream wraps it in 'var customFieldConfigs = JSON.parse(...)'; the CLI unwraps it — re-run with --json.

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI to turn any ePropertyPlus land bank's public listings into a uniform, queryable, exportable dataset — for distressed-land targeting, condition joins by parcel number, GIS export, and adaptive-reuse (Land Designer) inputs across multiple cities.
